question: Did any Moabite enter the congregation of the Lord?
summary: Deuteronomy 23:3 and Nehemiah 13:1 explicitly forbid Moabites from ever entering the assembly of YHWH, but the book of Ruth makes a Moabite woman the great-grandmother of King David — placing her, and her descendants, squarely inside the congregation.

reconcile.connective: Defenders argue the ban reached only male Moabites and never a proselyte wife, so Ruth's case falls outside it.

discrepancy.connective: Bernard S. Jackson, weighing Ruth against the Pentateuch, concludes the book's resolution does not accord with the Deuteronomic legal norm that bars every Moabite from the assembly.

skeptic.name: Bernard S. Jackson
skeptic.work: Ruth, the Pentateuch and the Nature of Biblical Law

pd_work.resource: Adam Clarke, Commentary on the Bible (1832), note on Ruth 4:13
pd_work.author: Adam Clarke
pd_work.note: Clarke treats this exact discrepancy at Ruth 4:13, arguing the Deuteronomic Moabite ban did not extend to women and that Ruth was in any case an exempt, already-incorporated proselyte. (Haley's specific coverage of this passage could not be confirmed, so the harmonizing commentator surfaced on the row is used.)

excerpts.attribution: Adam Clarke, Commentary on the Bible (1832)
excerpts.excerpt_text: The law of Moses had prohibited the Moabites, even to the tenth generation, from entering into the congregation of the Lord; but this law, the Jews think, did not extend to women; and even if it had, Ruth's might be considered an exempt case, as she had been already incorporated into the family by marriage; and left her own country, people, and gods, to become a proselyte to the true God in the land of Israel.
excerpts.on_tension_rationale: Directly names the Deut 23:3 Moabite-exclusion law as the difficulty and offers the two standard harmonizations in one verbatim sentence: the ban reaches only males, and Ruth was in any case a proselyte already incorporated by marriage. Strongest single reconcile statement on the row; parity-capped to one because the discrepancy pole carries one named-skeptic connective.
